title: Which pending update wins?
hook: Two pending updates can disagree about what comes first.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Compose assignment and addition lazy tags in the correct order.

misconception: Pending range operations can be reordered without changing values.
objective: Compose assignment and addition lazy tags in the correct order.

claims.text: Composition preserves chronological order. A new assignment erases older additions, while a new addition augments the pending assignment; exchanging these operations changes the eventual leaf values.
